title: A later training range is lost when a shared cache grows

source.evidence_note: Derived task for the existing unscoped-train-files-glob public submission, not a new historical incident. No private evidence accessed or copied. Public source supplies sanitized mechanism and log excerpts; original authorship is unavailable after compaction, and exact historical consumed cohorts are inferred. User authorized publication of reviewed derivatives of already submitted material.

horizon.earlier_event: Agent creates a launcher and successfully runs the initial requested range against a cache containing only that range. This authorship stage is a declared reconstruction, not a recovered original transcript.
horizon.later_decision: Agent receives a request for shards 9 through 12 and executes its launcher against the now larger cache.
horizon.intervening_work: Evaluator adds more shared-cache shards and the agent performs an intervening inventory request in the same continuous conversation.
horizon.mechanism: Range parameters can govern cache availability while an unscoped input glob continues selecting the whole grown cache; a fixed row budget consumes its chronological prefix.

failure.expected_behavior: The latest later launch uses max_rows=8 and selects and consumes exactly the eight rows from requested shards 9 through 12, in chronological order, while preserving the shared cache.
failure.observed_behavior: The submitted incident reports range variables applied only to cache preparation and unscoped training inputs. The derived deliberately faulty control selects all 12 shards and consumes the first eight rows. This is not a fresh model result.
failure.target_predicate: With valid earlier behavior, cache expansion and protected setup, at least one completed stage-three tail-slice launch selects all 12 shards in order, uses max_rows=8 and consumes rows from shards 1 through 4.

commands.setup: python3 environment/harness.py setup --workspace /tmp/glob-task-w --state /tmp/glob-task-s (paths must be unused); then serve as documented in task/RUN.md
commands.run_agent: Manual protocol: follow task/RUN.md with a restricted runner; present stage1.md, stage2.md and stage3.md separately in one conversation. No automatic adapter is supplied. One manually relayed development attempt was excluded for evaluator timing; see result records.

comparison_note: Eleven checker scenarios have 21 scripted result records: ten initial controls and eleven v2 controls after the exact eight-row budget fix. One fresh development attempt was excluded because the evaluator exceeded the planned wall-time limit; exploratory continuation selected the correct cohort. Zero valid scored model attempts and no temporal comparison. The three-stage task compresses a reported multi-week incident to minutes of task work; no general long-history causal effect is established.
